svg.title: How the assistant fits together
svg.desc: You chat on your phone with a Telegram bot, and the official channel plugin connects it to a Claude Code session that runs in tmux, in auto mode, on your Claude subscription, on an always-on machine of yours, set up as you like. The session reads and writes CLAUDE.md, its notes and memory, runs voice and browser tools, and uses the Gmail, Calendar and Drive connectors of claude.ai. Hooks on every tool call send its status and permission buttons to Telegram. A nightly cycle saves the day, reviews memory, updates and restarts it. Optionally, n8n alerts you directly when nothing needs thinking, and otherwise hands a one-line notice to the wake-up, which types it into the session; the session builds n8n workflows through MCP.
svg.text: OPTIONAL · NO TOKENS UNTIL SOMETHING HAPPENS
a container, a VM, a plain user or root: your call
